impactQuery:
PREFIX jolux: <http://data.legilux.public.lu/resource/ontology/jolux#>
SELECT DISTINCT ?work ?impact ?date ?target ?source WHERE {
 VALUES ?work { <https://fedlex.data.admin.ch/eli/cc/2010/267>
<https://fedlex.data.admin.ch/eli/cc/2010/262>
<https://fedlex.data.admin.ch/eli/cc/2006/218>
<https://fedlex.data.admin.ch/eli/cc/1969/737_757_755>
<https://fedlex.data.admin.ch/eli/cc/1978/688_688_688>
<https://fedlex.data.admin.ch/eli/cc/1978/712_712_712>
<https://fedlex.data.admin.ch/eli/cc/1994/1340_1340_1340>
<https://fedlex.data.admin.ch/eli/cc/63/837_843_843>
<https://fedlex.data.admin.ch/eli/cc/1959/827_857_845>
<https://fedlex.data.admin.ch/eli/cc/1961/29_29_29>
<https://fedlex.data.admin.ch/eli/cc/1982/1676_1676_1676>
<https://fedlex.data.admin.ch/eli/cc/1982/2184_2184_2184>
<https://fedlex.data.admin.ch/eli/cc/1983/1205_1205_1205>
<https://fedlex.data.admin.ch/eli/cc/1995/1328_1328_1328> }
 { ?impact jolux:impactToLegalResource ?work. BIND(?work AS ?target) }
 UNION
 { ?impact jolux:impactToLegalResource ?target. ?target jolux:legalResourceSubdivisionIsPartOf ?work. }
 ?impact jolux:legalResourceImpactHasDateEntryInForce ?date.
 OPTIONAL { ?impact jolux:impactFromLegalResource/jolux:legalResourceSubdivisionIsPartOf ?source }
 FILTER(str(?date) >= "2026-01-01" && str(?date) <= "2027-12-31")
} ORDER BY ?work ?date ?target
versionQuery:
PREFIX jolux: <http://data.legilux.public.lu/resource/ontology/jolux#>
SELECT DISTINCT ?work ?version ?from ?to WHERE {
 VALUES ?work { <https://fedlex.data.admin.ch/eli/cc/2010/267>
<https://fedlex.data.admin.ch/eli/cc/2010/262>
<https://fedlex.data.admin.ch/eli/cc/2006/218>
<https://fedlex.data.admin.ch/eli/cc/1969/737_757_755>
<https://fedlex.data.admin.ch/eli/cc/1978/688_688_688>
<https://fedlex.data.admin.ch/eli/cc/1978/712_712_712>
<https://fedlex.data.admin.ch/eli/cc/1994/1340_1340_1340>
<https://fedlex.data.admin.ch/eli/cc/63/837_843_843>
<https://fedlex.data.admin.ch/eli/cc/1959/827_857_845>
<https://fedlex.data.admin.ch/eli/cc/1961/29_29_29>
<https://fedlex.data.admin.ch/eli/cc/1982/1676_1676_1676>
<https://fedlex.data.admin.ch/eli/cc/1982/2184_2184_2184>
<https://fedlex.data.admin.ch/eli/cc/1983/1205_1205_1205>
<https://fedlex.data.admin.ch/eli/cc/1995/1328_1328_1328> }
 ?version jolux:isMemberOf ?work; jolux:dateApplicability ?from.
 OPTIONAL { ?version jolux:dateEndApplicability ?to }
 FILTER(str(?from) <= "2027-12-31" && (!BOUND(?to) || str(?to) >= "2026-01-01"))
} ORDER BY ?work ?from
